setting: indoor, residential kitchen table, Palo Alto
notes: Actually the Facebook founding team (Summer 2004), NOT Microsoft 1978. Shows ~7 young guys (including Zuckerberg and Moskovitz) with modern laptops (Sony VAIO visible) around a kitchen table. The current label is incorrect — the HTML already has the correct label 'Zuck & Team — Palo Alto (2004)'.

setting: studio, blue background
notes: Actually the original Microsoft staff photo (December 7, 1978, Albuquerque). Shows 11 of the 13 original employees with autographs: Bill Gates (lower left), Paul Allen (lower right), Steve Wood, Bob Wallace, Jim Lane, Bob Greenberg, Marc McDonald, Gordon Letwin, Andrea Lewis, Marla Wood, Ric Weiland, Miriam Lubow. The current label is incorrect — the HTML already has the correct label 'Microsoft Staff (1978)'.

setting: indoor, corporate office with Fairchild Semiconductor logo on brick wall
notes: Black and white photo of the eight scientists who left Shockley Semiconductor to found Fairchild Semiconductor in 1957, including Noyce and Moore. The Fairchild logo (stylized compass/crosshair) is visible on the wall behind them. This is the birth of Silicon Valley.

setting: studio/formal, Princeton University
notes: Young Alan Turing (age ~24) in tweed jacket and polka dot tie at Princeton University in 1936 — the same year he published 'On Computable Numbers,' the foundational paper of computer science.

setting: indoor, formal with American flag backdrop
notes: Grace Hopper in full U.S. Navy Commodore uniform with American flag behind her. Name badge reads 'COMO HOPPER'. Invented the first compiler, popularized 'debugging,' programmed the Harvard Mark I.

setting: indoor, MIT office/hallway
notes: Margaret Hamilton standing next to the entire Apollo Guidance Computer source code stack — a tower of printouts as tall as she is. Black and white photo. She's wearing glasses and a striped dress. The code on the chalkboard behind her is visible.

setting: indoor, Bell Labs with electronic equipment in background
notes: Black and white portrait of Claude Shannon at Bell Labs, father of information theory. He's looking pensive, with electronic equipment (possibly early computing machinery) visible in the background.

setting: indoor, Bell Labs
notes: Ken Thompson (left, large beard, big glasses) and Dennis Ritchie (right, clean-shaven, smiling) in black and white 1973 photo. Together they created Unix and the C programming language.

setting: Microsoft event stage with Microsoft and Windows logos
notes: Steve Ballmer sweaty and bent over on stage at a Microsoft event. Blue shirt soaked with sweat. Microsoft logo on the left, Windows logo on the right. This is the iconic 'Developers! Developers! Developers!' meme moment.

setting: indoor, Bill Gates' office with desk, computer monitor, bookshelves
notes: Still from the famous Connie Chung interview video where a young Bill Gates jumps over an office chair from a standing position. Shows Gates standing in his office near a desk with an early computer monitor.

setting: lecture hall / auditorium, Aalto University, Finland
notes: Linus Torvalds giving the middle finger during a talk at Aalto University in 2012. Wearing glasses, white dress shirt under dark blazer. The famous 'NVIDIA, f**k you' moment when asked about NVIDIA's Linux driver support.

setting: Tesla Gigafactory Shanghai event stage, large screen with Tesla car behind
notes: Elon Musk dancing awkwardly on stage at the Tesla Gigafactory Shanghai opening ceremony (January 2020). Wearing black outfit, arms out mid-dance move. Giant Tesla Model 3 projection visible behind him.

setting: D5 Conference stage, Carlsbad CA, red chairs, blue screens
notes: Steve Jobs (left, black turtleneck, jeans, sneakers) and Bill Gates (right, striped shirt, glasses) sitting in red Eames-style chairs at the D5 All Things Digital conference (2007), both laughing warmly. Photo by Joi Ito. Historic joint interview by Walt Mossberg.

setting: restaurant/dining room, Sonoma CA, white tablecloth
notes: Three men at a round restaurant table: Sendhil Mullainathan (left, glasses, white shirt), Elon Musk (center, blue polo), and Jeff Bezos (right, bald, striped shirt). Edge.org Master Class on behavioral economics, 2008, Sonoma. Years before the Musk-Bezos space rivalry. Diet Coke and water bottles on table.

current_label: Silicon Valley Meets the White House
setting: indoor, formal private dinner, Woodside CA
notes: President Obama (dark suit) greeting Mark Zuckerberg (dark jacket) at the famous 2011 Silicon Valley tech leaders dinner. Other attendees visible in background. Obama hosted Jobs, Zuckerberg, Schmidt, Ellison, and other tech CEOs.

setting: White House State Dining Room, formal dinner table with flowers
notes: White House dinner (September 2025): Mark Zuckerberg (left, curly hair), Donald Trump (center, navy suit, red tie), Melania Trump (black dress), Bill Gates (right, glasses). Formal dinner table with place cards, flower arrangements, and microphones. Reuters photo.

setting: Macworld stage, Moscone Center, San Francisco
notes: Steve Jobs on stage in black turtleneck and jeans, facing a massive projection of the original iPhone showing the home screen with original iOS icons (Phone, Mail, Safari, iPod at bottom). January 9, 2007 Macworld. 'An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator.'

setting: Apple shareholder meeting stage, Cupertino
notes: Young Steve Jobs in bow tie and dark suit presenting next to the original Macintosh computer (January 24, 1984). The Mac screen shows a fish drawing and text/menu. Black and white UPI photo. 'Hello, I am Macintosh.'

setting: COMPUTEX 2024 stage, Taipei, dark stage with NVIDIA Blackwell graphics
notes: Jensen Huang in signature black leather jacket holding the GB200 Grace Blackwell Superchip on stage. Background shows 'AI SUPERCHIP 208B Transistors', 'TRANSFORMER ENGINE FP4/FP6 Tensor Core', '5th GENERATION', and 'NVIDIA BLACKWELL' with Chinese characters.

setting: Silicon Valley Virtual Reality conference (SVVR 2014)
notes: Palmer Luckey wearing the Oculus Development Kit 1 VR headset (labeled 'Oculus Development Kit') with over-ear headphones. Gray t-shirt, SVVR lanyard. Built the first prototype in his parents' garage, sold to Facebook for $2B at age 21.

setting: outdoor, road/highway with concrete wall, motion blur
notes: Red Tesla Roadster (original prototype) driving at speed with the convertible top down. Driver wearing sunglasses. Motion blur on background and wheels. Tesla's first vehicle, debuted July 2006 at Santa Monica Airport. The electric sports car that proved EVs could be desirable.

setting: formal studio, MIT yearbook
notes: Black and white yearbook portrait of young Morris Chang in suit and tie from the 1951 MIT yearbook. Decades before founding TSMC at age 55. The man who would revolutionize semiconductor manufacturing and make Taiwan the center of the chip world.
